That could all change in just a few weeks. We’ve been hearing about an iPad mini update for months, and according to a new report from MacRumors , it could be coming soon. Based on a leak from “Apple’s own code,” a new iPad mini could arrive next month with several new features, including a landscape front-facing camera and Apple’s newest A20 Pro processor.

The current iPad mini uses an A17 Pro processor, which was the previous-generation processor at the time of its release. The current A19 Pro processor is incredibly powerful and would give the iPad mini an incredible speed boost and 50 percent more RAM–12GB versus 8GB in the A17 Pro.

The landscape camera would also be a significant upgrade, as the iPad mini is Apple’s only tablet to still feature a portrait-style camera.
